title: Fallacy in Logical Reasoning — False Dilemma | Fallacy Busters
skills: define and recognize the false dilemma fallacy
identify arguments that restrict choices to an incomplete set of alternatives
consider additional possibilities excluded by a misleading either-or claim
evaluate reasoning for completeness, fairness, and logical soundness
alignment_note: Provides a focused explanation of the false dilemma fallacy and how either-or reasoning can conceal valid alternatives. Supports logical-fallacy recognition, argument analysis, critical thinking, rhetorical literacy, and evidence-based discussion across high school English courses.
